title: Turbofan preliminary design for regional aircraft case study.
author: Rafael dos Santos Silva
abstract: This study establishes which stages are necessary to generate the preliminary design of a turbofan's rotating machinery. A system consisted of fan, booster, high pressure compressor and turbine was developed to power the ERJ-190 from Embraer but the same could be extended to other regional aircrafts. The objective was for that engine to be more economical in long and short term than the one present used. A final comparison table shows that the goals were successfully addressed by choosing in a different design point and keeping the engine as simple as possible.
